newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Tanzania clamp on Burundi border cuts refugee flow.
newsitem.headline: Tanzania clamp on Burundi border cuts refugee flow.

text.p: Tightened security along Tanzania's border with Burundi has cut the flow of refugees from Burundi to a trickle, the government-owned Sunday News reported.

It quoted Kagera Regional Commissioner Mohamed Babu as saying about 10 to 15 refugees were entering Tanzania each day, compared with several hundred before economic sanctions were imposed on Burundi following the July 25 military coup there.
Quoting from Tanzanian army intelligence reports, he said: "We have been informed that the situation in Burundi is very bad. Heavy fighting is going on there."
Babu said the Burundian army had sealed the area on its side of the border in a bid to capture Hutu rebels, while Tanzania had stepped up its own border controls.

He said trucks carrying humanitarian supplies for refugees and displaced people in Burundi were still being allowed to cross, but security on Lake Tanganyika had been stepped up to prevent goods being smuggled to Burundi across the lake.
